purpose: Append-only record of every runtime experiment. A paid experiment must have a record here BEFORE it executes; tests/research-program.test.ts enforces that every experiment id appearing in the budget ledger has one.
immutabilityRule: Records are never rewritten to make a later result look cleaner. A superseded design gets a NEW record and the old one is marked with supersededBy. Estimated figures are left as estimated even when actuals differ.
backfillNote: Records for experiments run before this registry existed are marked backfilled: true. Their preregistration was prose in the operator conversation rather than a committed record, which is the gap this registry closes. Their estimates are recorded as null rather than reconstructed after the fact, because inventing a pre-registration estimate from a known actual is exactly the dishonesty the registry exists to prevent.

records.question: Does model-normalised structured work representation bridge a vocabulary gap that token overlap cannot cross?
records.hypothesis: agent-blueprint beats experience-lexical on experience NDCG@10 with a paired 95% interval excluding zero.
records.successCriterion: CI excludes zero and the mean difference is positive.
records.failureCriterion: Mean difference negative with CI excluding zero.
records.caveat: Interpretation cache irrecoverable: gitignored and lost with the machine. Result is citable but not recomputable, and no per-person cross-provider pairing is possible.

records.question: What reasoning setting and output allowance do the real prompts need without truncating?
records.hypothesis: Sizing question, not a quality hypothesis.
records.successCriterion: An allowance that does not truncate at the chosen effort.
records.result: Person output 886 tokens at low, 2027 at medium, 1304 at high. The Anthropic arm's 1200 allowance would have truncated at medium and high.
records.caveat: One person and one job. Sufficient for sizing, never for a quality claim.

records.question: Does the Claude bridge result replicate on a different vendor's model?
records.hypothesis: The effect is a property of the representation, not of one model.
records.successCriterion: CI excludes zero, positive, and comparable in magnitude to the Claude arm.
records.failureCriterion: Sign differs from the Claude arm.
records.result: experience +0.241 CI [0.123, 0.351], within 0.006 of the Claude arm. agent-field-match reaches 0.709 / 0.693 / 0.878.
records.caveat: Reasoning 'low' is not proven quantitatively equivalent across vendors. Establishes 'not provider-specific', not 'caused exclusively by representation'.

records.question: Does the agent representation hold when overlapping wording is adversarial?
records.hypothesis: agent-blueprint beats experience-lexical on the trap family.
records.failureCriterion: Mean difference negative or CI spanning zero.
records.result: The stated hypothesis FAILED: agent-blueprint 0.597 vs 0.622, delta -0.025 CI [-0.128, 0.067], and no channel beat lexical. The same run showed agent-field-match at 0.745, +0.148 CI [0.088, 0.211] over agent-blueprint - a matcher result, recorded separately as R-01.
records.caveat: Rejected as stated. The field-match finding is a secondary observation from the same data, not the preregistered hypothesis.

records.question: Does the architecture regress on ordinary cases?
records.successCriterion: No regression with CI excluding zero.
records.result: Stopped at 12/12 person and 35/288 job interpretations by operator instruction. All committed. Continuation is NOT authorized; partial cache is not a reason to finish the arm.
records.caveat: Provider-specific incomplete arm. Must never be read as a negative result. Status moved IN_PROGRESS → DEFERRED on 2026-08-23 because IN_PROGRESS was being read as execution priority. Actuals and caches are unchanged.

records.question: Do dedicated Experience and Direction agents beat one shared CareerBlueprint call?
records.hypothesis: split-full-context beats shared on direction without raising contamination.
records.successCriterion: Direction CI excludes zero, positive, without raising contamination.
records.failureCriterion: Direction regression with CI excluding zero.
records.result: Direction collapsed 0.732 to 0.457 / 0.447, CIs excluding zero. INVALID AS A TEST OF SPECIALISATION: the v1 Direction prompt defined WANTED to include work the person enjoys, and the 'isolated' arm was still shown preference evidence. Two independent defects pointing the same way; provenance confirmed 81/129 and 83/132 desired claims sourced from LIKE evidence.
records.caveat: Rejected as an implementation, not as evidence against specialisation. 16 of the actual calls were sunk on a truncated first attempt at a 1800 allowance.

records.question: Does a correctly channel-scoped Direction Agent, shown only aspiration evidence, beat the shared blueprint?
records.hypothesis: Direction retrieval is preserved or improved without absorbing Preference items.

frozenConfig.evidenceRouting: isolated Direction sees aspiration evidence only

records.successCriterion: Direction CI excludes zero, positive, with contamination not increased.
records.failureCriterion: Direction regression with CI excluding zero.
records.result: Channel integrity fully repaired: provenance contamination 0.629 to 0.000, desired volume 2.750 to 1.000. Retrieval unresolved: isolated direction 0.806 vs shared 0.732, paired +0.074 CI [-0.066, 0.198]. Experience bit-identical from cache, so the ablation is clean.
records.caveat: Preference is NOT PRODUCED by this architecture and its column must not be read as a regression. Latency for the v2 Direction agent (p50 6808ms) was measured at run time and is not recoverable from cache.

records.question: Does the provider boundary work end to end?
records.hypothesis: Plumbing check only. Never used for a scored result.
records.successCriterion: Provider reachable, structured output parses, cache prevents a second call, secrets absent.
records.result: Operational probe. Not a quality experiment.
records.caveat: A successful smoke test proves plumbing. No number from it may be reported as an architecture result.

records.question: Can the strongest one-call baseline gain claim-level auditability without specialist inference?
records.hypothesis: Adding a required per-item evidence field to person-blueprint@v2 preserves retrieval under the frozen field-aware matcher and yields provenance contamination at or below 0.05.

frozenConfig.matcherPolicy: frozen; R-01 is diagnostic only and must not retune fields

records.successCriterion: Retrieval holds (CI spans zero or better) AND provenance contamination <= 0.05.
records.failureCriterion: Retrieval regresses with a CI excluding zero.
records.inconclusiveCriterion: Retrieval CI spans zero and is negative, or contamination is unmeasurable.
records.result: SUPPORTED / Case A for auditability/provenance. No statistically detectable retrieval regression: experience Δ −0.019 CI [−0.097, 0.054]. Equivalence/non-inferiority has NOT been established. Provenance contamination 0.000 on all four quote channels (72/84/24/48 claims), volume ratio 1.000. T-01 KEEP set stable across 25 threshold pairs. Direction point estimate −0.062 CI [−0.172, 0.043] is compatible with a meaningful regression or a small improvement. Fresh person p50 14.7s. Not shipped.
records.caveat: One generation. A CI spanning zero is not equivalence. S-01 (amended) must measure representation, ranking, provenance, and architecture-decision variance before this is treated as an architecture-decision-stable baseline. Do not invent non-inferiority margins from these observed deltas.

records.question: Would we reach the same architectural decision if the model regenerated the same person's blueprint from identical prompt bytes?
records.hypothesis: The sign of field-match vs lexical and of shared-provenance KEEP rates stays the same across 4 independent fresh person-blueprint@v2 generations, and ranking rank-correlation is high.
primaryMetrics: sign stability of field-match vs lexical experience NDCG@10
sign stability of v2 vs v1 experience and direction deltas
Experience KEEP rate vs 0.90 across trials
records.successCriterion: Every listed architectural sign is identical across all 4 trials and Experience KEEP stays at or above 0.90.
records.failureCriterion: Any listed architectural sign flips in 2 or more trials.
records.inconclusiveCriterion: Exactly one trial flips a sign, or rank-correlation is moderate.
records.result: Never executed. Superseded before spend because the first draft used sign-majority as the decision rule and treated a CI spanning zero as retrieval equivalence. Methodological amendment is stochastic-stability:openai:LEXICAL_TRAP:low:amended.
records.caveat: Unexecuted first draft. Kept so the sign-majority justification remains visible rather than silently rewritten.

records.question: How much variation is introduced by repeated inference under identical semantic input, and can that variation change TaskDNA's representation, recommendations, or architecture decisions?
records.hypothesis: Fresh person-blueprint@v2 generations from identical prompt/input bytes produce representation, ranking, and provenance variation small enough that the written P-01 Case A conclusion would still stand, while also characterizing the Direction Δ distribution that a single generation cannot resolve. Field-match vs token-bag advantage, computed on the same interpretation each trial, keeps the same qualitative conclusion.

frozenConfig.v1Baseline: one frozen historical realization; not a symmetric stochastic comparison of both architectures
frozenConfig.nonInferiorityReason: P-01 CIs are too wide, and the product has no declared NDCG loss budget. Inventing 0.05 or 0.10 from the observed P-01 deltas would be circular. Treat non-inferiority as unresolved. Report the full trial-level delta distribution.

primaryMetrics: representation: per-channel volume mean/range/SD and pairwise work-identity Jaccard
ranking: NDCG@10 variance, Recall@10 variance, recommendation churn at K=10, top-1/3/5/10 overlap, Spearman rank correlation
provenance: contamination / unsupported / ambiguous rates by trial
architecture-decision: trial-level v2 vs frozen-v1 paired deltas (experience, preference, direction) with full magnitude; whether P-01 Case A would still stand
matcher-stability: field-match vs token-bag paired delta on the identical interpretation each trial
records.successCriterion: Four separate verdicts (REPRESENTATION / RANKING / PROVENANCE / ARCHITECTURE_DECISION), each SUPPORTED / CONCERN / INCONCLUSIVE. Do not collapse to one PASS/FAIL. Sign counts are descriptive only. Non-inferiority is unresolved and cannot KEEP or REJECT this item by itself.
records.failureCriterion: PROVENANCE_STABILITY is CONCERN (contamination or unsupported rates fluctuate materially above the P-01 0.05 ceiling) OR ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_STABILITY is CONCERN because a fresh v2 generation would have changed the written P-01 Case A conclusion (contamination > 0.05 or experience paired CI excludes zero downward) OR RANKING_STABILITY is CONCERN because mean pairwise recommendation churn at K=10 is large enough that users would see a different job set while average NDCG barely moves.
records.inconclusiveCriterion: Distributions are wide enough that SUPPORTED vs CONCERN cannot be distinguished at n=12 people × 4 trials, or representation varies while rankings and provenance stay stable and the product impact of wording/frame variation is not yet defined.
records.result: Amended and preregistered. Dry-run only. Paid execution not authorized.
records.caveat: Measures stochastic variation of v2 relative to one frozen historical v1 realization. Does not measure variance of both architectures. Four trials cannot establish conventional power, equivalence, prompt robustness, or population generalization.
